# NU — NOI-companion-use role profile r0.5

Exact role: admission/use of a compatible NOI child on 'V_NOI'. It binds
'K_NOI', population/membership authority, identical resolved transformation,
support, normalization, profile, failure policy, request status, lifecycle,
and provenance. Per-member Learn/Resolve and result-dependent admission are
forbidden. A missing or unrequested NOI child does not block SP.
